appended_contract: Output code vocabulary (format definitions, not evidence about this task): action=call means attempt the named tool, status=working; completion is not yet known. action=ask means request missing information or authorization. Use status=need_auth when authentication is missing, status=need_info when user information is missing. action=finish with status=completed means the requested effects have already occurred and there is actual supporting evidence. action=defer uses status=deferred. For non-call actions use tool=none and arguments={}. The message must agree with the status and actual tool outcomes. Do not turn a request for login/time into a completed status.
